gloss: slowly and carefully, thoroughly, taking one's time

definitions.explanation: Taking sufficient time to do something carefully and thoroughly without rushing.

examples.japanese: じっくり⟦{考|かんが}えて→考える：00856_kangaeru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{返事|へんじ}→返事：00844_henji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I'll think it over carefully before replying.

examples.japanese: ⟦{肉|にく}→肉：02240_niku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧じっくり⟦{煮込|にこ}む→煮込む：05822_nikomu⟧。
じっくり⟦{話|はな}し{合|あ}う→話し合う：02396_hanashiau⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{欲|ほ}しい→欲しい：01107_hoshii⟧。
examples.english: I want time to have a thorough discussion.

notes:
COMMON PATTERNS:
- じっくり⟦{考|かんが}える→考える：00856_kangaeru⟧ (to think carefully)
- じっくり⟦{話|はな}し{合|あ}う→話し合う：02396_hanashiau⟧ (to have a thorough discussion)
- じっくり⟦{煮込|にこ}む→煮込む：05822_nikomu⟧ (to simmer slowly)
- じっくり⟦{読|よ}む→読む：00426_yomu⟧ (to read carefully)
- じっくり⟦{取|と}り{組|く}む→取り組む：04225_torikumu⟧ (to work on something thoroughly)

USAGE:
Emphasizes taking adequate time without rushing. Often implies a positive approach that leads to better results through patience and care.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- じっくり emphasizes taking time carefully
- ⟦ゆっくり→ゆっくり：00910_yukkuri⟧ emphasizes slow speed or relaxation
- ⟦{念入|ねんい}り→念入り：14892_neniri⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ emphasizes meticulousness

COOKING USAGE:
Very common in cooking contexts for slow-cooking methods that develop flavor.
